nom: SUNDAY RILEY A+ High-Dose Retinoid Serum

segments.oily: One reviewer's 21-year-old daughter with acne-prone skin had dramatic results using it.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the serum helped their skin absorb moisturizer better, stopped flakiness even in winter, and did not cause peeling or dryness for some, though others describe purging with dryness before improvement.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination, mostly dry, sensitive skin says it sits nicely as long as harsh exfoliants aren't used beforehand.
segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers tolerate it well with no peeling, flaking or irritation once eased in gradually, describing it as gentle for a strong retinoid; a minority still report stinging, tearing eyes, redness or peeling, especially if used nightly from the start.
segments.mature: Reviewers aged 41 to 73 report smoother, tighter, brighter skin with faded fine lines, laugh lines and age spots, calling it effective for aging skin.
segments.normal: One reviewer without notably problematic skin still saw a rough patch clear after one application and reports the product also helped with redness and dark spots.

concerns.aging: Multiple reviewers in their 30s to 70s report fading fine lines, smoothed forehead and smile lines, tighter skin, and fewer age spots or sun spots after weeks to months of use; a couple used it specifically to address crow's feet or laugh lines with visible results, though one found it did nothing for her overall.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers say the serum resolved dryness and helped moisturizer absorb better, with no flaking even in winter; others describe an initial dry, flaky or peeling phase, and one reviewer stopped use because it made her eyes tear and burn.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea-prone sensitive skin reports it improved redness using a two-days-on/two-days-off schedule; another developed redness on the chin after nightly use and had to scale back to every other night.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers report no barrier disruption or peeling even with regular use; one reviewer explicitly developed signs of a damaged barrier (redness) on the chin from overuse and had to reduce frequency.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report fading dark spots, age spots and sun spots, with one dermatologist no longer flagging concern about pre-cancerous spots after continued use.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers with acne-prone or hormonal acne report clearing of breakouts, whiteheads and blemishes within days to weeks, including one whose daughter saw dramatic results; a few instead report purging with whiteheads or occasional pimples at the temples, and one reviewer using it irregularly says missed nights bring pimples back.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports the product eliminated visible sebaceous filaments on the nose over a year of use; no other oiliness-specific comments appear.

aspects.libelle: Gradual easing-in required to avoid irritation

extraits.titre: Let this be your one skincare splurge
extraits.texte: This review is not sponsored! This stuff is the TRUTH! Let me start off by saying I have VERY dry, sensitive-ish (but exercised) skin. I used this a few years back and I had poreless, clear, (almost) line free, glowing, even skin. I went out looking for something else because of the absurd price point of this product. I have tried retinoids/retinols/retinals from all different brands and price points to try to find something less expensive that worked…nope. All of them made me so dry and peely to the point that everytime I even WASHED my face, it stung horribly. This product in particular has a lot of buffers/hydrating ingredients in it to keep the retinoids in it from being super irritating. Begrudgingly, I picked this up from Ulta a few days ago and have used it twice since then. Pores have completely diminished, clear, glowing, lines are less visible, my skin isn't angrily peeling. I now remember what justified me to spend $100< /> a bottle in the first place

I'm a 20 year old girl who has suffered from hormonal and regular acne for years and this is this only product that can smooth out my skin in 1 (one) night. It is insane how well this works. Small bumps will be gone overnight. This is labeled as high dose but I have very sensitive skin yet I can use it day and night. I cannot recommend this product enough.

extraits.titre: definitely a high dose of retinol!
extraits.texte: This is a powerful retinol serum that is no joke. I tried easing into it by going every other night, then moved to every night. I ended up with signs of a damaged skin barrier (redness) on my chin. I'm going to lay off this on my chin for a couple weeks, then try again, but stick to every other night. I love that I'm getting a strong dose of an excellent skincare ingredient, but I need to take care not to overdo it.

This is truly I product I didn't know I needed. I saw it on sale during Ulta's 21-days of beauty and I'm so glad I took a chance on it. It has done wonders on my complexion, redness, dryness and dark spots. I had a rough area on my temple and it was gone after one application! I don't have terrible skin to begin with and I do have sensitive skin with some rosacea. I have been tolerating this serum well using the two days on/two days off method and likely will keep up that routine instead of using this everyday given my sensitivity. Based on the reviews looks like it is hit or miss if your skin can handle it. I'm so glad I had to sense to buy two during the sale but now I'm annoyed that I love it so much because it's definitely not a cheap product.

A+ is an excellent retinoid for aging, mature skin. My skin is brighter and smoother and the fine lines are fading away. I add a few drops of the Luna Night Oil and I have had no sensitivity to either product (I did start out alternating the two products). My skin is dry and this seems to have helped my skin absorb my moisturizer more than it has in the past. Also, my 21 year old daughter has been using it on her acne prone skin. She has had dramatic results. Love it!!!
I wanted to like this as it helped with my crows feet, but, i couldnt get past the smell and it made my eyes tear up from burn& tear!

Quite honestly though as long as you're using the 1-2 pumps as recommended you won't go through it super fast so it'll last over time. I haven't seen a product work so fast and also so well in a while. I pair this with other products, but this seems to be the one that really changed my skin for the better. I have combination mostly dry sensitive skin and as long as I'm not doing a harsh exfoliant before the serum sits so nicely on my skin.
